title: Reading vowel teams: ai, ee and oa

explain.say: Vowels are the letters a, e, i, o and u. Sometimes two vowels work together. Look at the word rain on the board. The a and the i make one sound.

draw.text: Reading vowel teams: ai, ee and oa

explain.say: Look at the middle part: a and i. Together they say the name of the letter a. You hear it in rain and train. Two letters, one sound. Say rain.
Look at the word feet. Two e letters are together. They say the name of the letter e, as in see and tree. Tap 3 sounds and blend to read feet.
Look at the word boat. The o and the a are together. They say the name of the letter o, as in boat and goat. Tap 3 sounds and blend.
Look at the board. Each vowel team has its own group of words. Read the words in one group. Today, say 3 words with ee to a grown-up.

faq.a: A vowel team is two letters that make one vowel sound together. Examples are ai in rain, ee in feet and oa in boat.
ai usually says the name of the letter a, like in rain, tail and paint.
ee says the name of the letter e, like in see, tree and feet.
oa says the name of the letter o, like in boat, coat and road.

faq.q: How can I remember the vowel teams?
faq.a: Draw a little loop around the two letters, so your eyes see them as one. Make a picture card for each team: a rain cloud for ai, a tree for ee and a boat for oa.
asks: How do I remember ai, ee and oa?

facts: Rain, feet and boat each have four letters but only three sounds.
The vowel teams ai, ee and oa usually make the sound of a vowel letter name.

quiz.say: Listen to the word tree. What sound do the 2 e letters make?
quiz.show: 🌳 tree: what sound does ee make?

options.say: the name of the letter e

quiz.why: The 2 e letters work as a team. They say the name of the letter e.

wrong.0: The e in egg is the short sound of a single e.
wrong.1: The ai team makes the sound in rain, a different sound.

quiz.say: Which word has the same vowel sound as boat?
quiz.why: Coat has the oa team. It says the name of the letter o, as in boat.

wrong.0: Cot has one o, which makes the short sound in hot.
wrong.2: Cat has one a, which makes the short sound in apple.
